notes: Ollama backend. Each model's digest is the prefix of its /api/tags digest on the run machine; the runner refuses a tag that resolves to anything else. Every sampling option below is sent on every request, so Modelfile defaults (stock Qwen 3.5's presence_penalty 1.5, Ollama's repeat_penalty 1.1) never apply. supports_thinking is checked against the server. The judge digest is not pinned yet: pull the judge, then copy its digest in. The previous vLLM / Hugging Face setup is in config_vllm.json.
